newsitem.title: UK: IPE crude oil dragged sharply lower by NYMEX losse.
newsitem.headline: IPE crude oil dragged sharply lower by NYMEX losse.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil sank further on Tuesday afternoon in line with hefty losses in NYMEX energy futures at the open, traders said.
July IPE Brent was trading 82 cents lower at $19.18 a barrel at 1419 GMT, having spent most of the session prior to NYMEX's open around $19.70.

"We're just seeing some stop-loss liquidation. One (WTI) broker had a stop around $21.30 for about 300 lots and that's gone. I think the funds were all prepared to stay long while July (WTI) stayed around the $21.50 mark and now they're getting out," said one trader.
